svg.title: Ketover Platonic doubling: connected sheets and face-center necks
svg.desc: A full surface and cutaway show the cube sweepout model with six radial necks and genus five. Five smaller models compare tetrahedral, cubical, octahedral, dodecahedral and icosahedral face-center arrangements. Original construction schematic, not computed self-shrinkers. Compactness of the min-max limits is not proved.

g.text: Construction picture: two spherical sheets joined at face centers
Cut edges are a viewing aid
SCHEMATIC · not a numerical solution of the shrinker equation
The models are compact; compactness and ends of Ketover’s min-max limits remain undetermined.
